arrangement.notes: Arrangement features a sample-based bed with textured layers and one-shot hits to emphasize hooks with a dark mood and minimal variation.

texture_bed.description: longer atmospheric sample loops forming the texture bed

one_shot_hits.description: percussive samples based on slicing and sample segmentation techniques

sound_intent.sample_layer: sample-based arrangement with textured beds for atmosphere and one-shot hits for rhythmic hooks
sound_intent.texture_bed: dark, minimal and evolving texture pads
sound_intent.one_shot_hits: crisply segmented percussive hits using sample cutting techniques

routing_intent.drums: routed through sample slicing channel with transient shaper
routing_intent.bass: low-pass filtered and side-chained to drums
routing_intent.chords: sustained sample textures layered with reverb
routing_intent.fx: ambient washes and risers using granular sample manipulation

track_roles.drums: hook-driver and rhythmic base with segmented hits
track_roles.bass: supportive low end with minimal movement

designer_intent.focus: create a dark trip hop arrangement that emphasizes hooks through sample-based layers with minimal variation to evoke mood and texture.

presetor_intent.guidelines: apply sample-based textures and segmented one-shot hits as channels, maintain minimal variation but strong hook presence.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythmic drum patterns using sample segmentation and one-shot hits to create a hook-heavy but minimal percussive arrangement.

bass_generator.brief: Design a subdued bass line that supports the dark mood with minimal variations, synced lightly to the drums.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce atmospheric chord layers using sample-based textures that fill the space without overwhelming the arrangement.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse melody elements comprised of one-shot sample hits, emphasizing hooks with minimal melodic movement.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate overall arrangement structure focusing on energy variations aligning with hook prominence and dark mood.

presetor.brief: Apply production presets emphasizing sample slicing, transient shaping, reverb, and delay to maintain minimal but deep texture.

songgps.brief: Provide arrangement guidance ensuring sections conform to the minimal trip hop style with pronounced hooks and dark atmosphere.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Manage mixing with focus on clarity of segmented sample hits, sustaining dark texture, and preserving hook energy.
